project.name: GymBuddy AI
project.description: AI gym & nutrition coach: a RAG chatbot with guardrails inside a web platform (muscle map, gym chrono, nutrition), deployed on Vercel, with n8n automations.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application: every HTTP route of the chatbot API (auth, users, chat, vision, conversations, ratings, feedback, muscles, workouts, nutrition, restaurants, n8n digest, admin stats) plus the signed-token restore used on Vercel.

nodes.name: chatbot.py
nodes.summary: The chatbot pipeline. answer() runs input guardrails → muscle detection → sliding-window history → BM25 retrieval → LLM (or offline composer) → output checks → sources. Also fridge meals, barcode (Open Food Facts) and the 3-in-1 vision scanner.

nodes.name: llm.py
nodes.summary: Provider-agnostic, OpenAI-compatible LLM client. Lists the 6 selectable OpenRouter models, caps reasoning tokens, tries fallback models on error/429/empty answer, calls vision models and generates dish images.

nodes.name: retrieval.py
nodes.summary: Loads the JSON knowledge base (exercises, foods, recipes, principles, equipment) into 281 documents and ranks them with a hand-written BM25, boosted by the selected muscle and filtered by equipment and allergens. Also detects muscles in EN/FR text.

nodes.name: guardrails.py
nodes.summary: Quality and safety control. check_input blocks prompt injection, steroids, eating-disorder behaviour, off-topic and empty/too-long messages before any AI call; check_output adds allergy, injury and medical warnings.

nodes.name: nutrition.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic calculator: Mifflin-St Jeor BMR × activity factor, goal adjustment, calorie floor, protein/carbs/fat and water targets. The AI never computes these numbers.

nodes.name: schemas.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models that validate every request and response (profile, chat, auth, restaurants, feedback…). Invalid input becomes an HTTP 422 with a clear message.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy tables: User (profile, plan, password hash), Conversation, Message (rating, flags, latency), Feedback.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: Database engine and session (SQLite locally or in /tmp on Vercel, any Postgres through DATABASE_URL).

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Reads every environment variable into one Settings object (provider, models, keys, history window, top-k, CORS…).

nodes.name: email_service.py
nodes.summary: Sends 6-digit verification/reset codes through Brevo, Resend or Gmail SMTP, whichever is configured.

nodes.name: places.py
nodes.summary: Optional Google Places (New) search for restaurants with photos, ratings and opening hours, plus AI dish suggestions per place.

nodes.name: index.py
nodes.summary: Vercel serverless entry point: exposes the FastAPI app as a Python function.

nodes.name: run_eval.py
nodes.summary: Runs the 16-question evaluation set against the chatbot and writes pass rate and latency (results.json / results_mock.json).

nodes.name: test_api.py

nodes.name: test_units.py

tour.title: The problem and the product
tour.description: Gym beginners piece advice together from videos, forums and several apps; generic chatbots ignore their body, equipment, diet and injuries. GymBuddy AI is one web platform built around a coach chatbot that knows your profile. Start with the README and the project context.

tour.title: What the user sees
tour.description: The /coach page is the heart: daily targets on the left, the chat in the middle, the clickable muscle map on the right. Other pages add the in-gym chrono, nutrition and accounts.

tour.title: From the browser to the API
tour.description: Every call goes through api.ts to /api/*. Next.js forwards it to FastAPI, so the browser never sees an API key and there is no CORS issue.

tour.title: One chat message, step by step
tour.description: POST /api/chat calls chatbot.answer(): (1) input guardrails, (2) detect the muscle, (3) keep the last 10 messages and expand short follow-ups, (4) BM25 retrieval, (5) the LLM writes the answer, (6) output warnings, then sources are attached.

tour.title: Quality control: guardrails
tour.description: check_input stops prompt injection, steroids, starvation diets and off-topic requests before any AI call. check_output adds allergy, injury and medical warnings after it.

tour.title: Grounding: retrieval over our own knowledge base
tour.description: 281 documents built from the JSON files are ranked with BM25, boosted by the selected muscle, filtered by equipment and allergens. The model must cite them as [S1], [S2]…

tour.title: Context management
tour.description: Each prompt contains the profile, the formula targets, the selected muscle, the last 10 messages and the retrieved documents; older messages drop out to keep prompts small.

tour.title: The LLM layer and its fallback
tour.description: llm.py speaks the OpenAI format to OpenRouter. The user can pick Auto or one of 5 models; on error, 429 or empty answer the next model is tried, and if all fail the offline composer answers from the documents. The UI badge shows who answered.

tour.title: Numbers come from code
tour.description: Calories, protein, carbs, fat and water are computed with Mifflin-St Jeor in nutrition.py, never guessed by the AI.

tour.title: Multimodal features
tour.description: A photo goes to a vision model (machine, plate or barcode); barcodes use Open Food Facts; the fridge chef writes meals and generates a dish picture.

tour.title: Data storage
tour.description: Users, conversations, messages (with rating, flags and latency) and feedback are SQLAlchemy tables; SQLite locally, temporary on Vercel, Postgres via DATABASE_URL.

tour.title: Tests and evaluation
tour.description: 32 pytest tests check maths, retrieval and guardrails; the 16-question evaluation measures answer quality (100 % offline, 87.5 % with the live model).

tour.title: Deployment and automation
tour.description: Two Vercel projects host the platform and the API. n8n workflows call the API for daily coaching e-mails, a CRM and a Telegram coach.
